sections.bodyEn: **Kexin Xiang** is currently a Ph.D. student in the [Department of Physics and Materials (PM)](https://www.polyu.edu.hk/pm/) of [The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU)](https://www.polyu.edu.hk/), Hong Kong SAR, P. R. China. He joined Professor Yan’s Organic Electronics Group in 2024 after he obtained the bachelor degree of engineering from the [Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE)](https://eee.sustech.edu.cn/) of [Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech)](https://www.sustech.edu.cn/), Shenzhen, P. R. China. His research interests focus on organic electrochemical transistors and their neuromorphic applications.
sections.bodyZh: 向柯鑫现为香港理工大学应用物理系博士研究生。他在中国深圳南方科技大学电气与电子工程系获得工学学士学位后，于2024年加入严教授的有机电子研究课题组。主要研究方向为有机电化学晶体管及其神经形态学应用。

sections.bodyEn: The article's author biography identifies Kexin Xiang as a PhD student in the Department of Applied Physics at [The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU)](https://www.polyu.edu.hk/), Hong Kong SAR. The article lists the Department of Applied Physics and Research Center for Organic Electronics as his affiliation.
sections.bodyZh: 论文作者简介记载，Kexin Xiang 是[香港理工大学](https://www.polyu.edu.hk/)应用物理学系博士生。论文列出的署名单位为应用物理学系及有机电子研究中心，所在地为中国香港特别行政区。
